text: I can compute average latency and database load from a hit ratio, hit cost and miss cost.
I can list the cache layers from browser to buffer pool with a rough latency for each.
I can explain which Cache-Control headers make a response cacheable by browsers and CDNs, and why versioned asset URLs exist.
I can compare an in-process cache with a distributed cache on duplication, consistency and cost per lookup.
I can explain why a buffer pool hit is still slower than an application cache hit.
I can decide whether a given piece of data should be cached, and what its cache key must include.
